Thanks again for the demo last week. Atlas would like to move from demo -> hands-on POC: a 2-hour plugfest where your team helps us exercise routing policies, fallback behavior, and a short load run against our non-prod dataset. Key goals:

- Validate regional routing (us-east vs us-west) and warm KV cache behavior
